about_the_game:
EREBUS-9 is an immersive first-person survival psychological horror retelling of Dante’s Inferno. You’ll need to explore the derelict space station to discover what happened, solve puzzles to progress and survive the horrors that await. Will you be able to uncover the dark secrets of the Erebus-9? 

EXPLORE THE DERELICT SPACE STATION

Explore the eerie, abandoned corridors of the research station Erebus-9 to uncover the twisted tale of what transpired. Each new discovery unravels another layer of the mystery, but beware... some secrets are better left uncovered.

SOLVE PUZZLES TO PROGRESS

Unlock the station's secrets by solving puzzles that block your path forward. What seems like a simple obstacle might be hiding something more sinister behind it. Solve your way to safety, but don’t forget: danger could be right behind you.

Please note

Erebus-9 is currently in development. We are planning to release an updated demo in March 2026.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060

short_description: Erebus-9 is an immersive first-person psychological horror. Explore the derelict space station, solve puzzles, and run from the horrors that reside onboard. As you descend deeper into the station, uncover its dark secrets and the tragedy that unfolded.
